calls.statement:
SELECT s.format, count(*) lines, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) receipts, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) rl, sum(f.net_amount) net, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id<900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH l AS (
 SELECT s.store_id, f.sale_date, f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, p.category
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'),
a AS (SELECT store_id, sale_date, sum(net_amount) n, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) r FROM l GROUP BY 1,2),
c AS (SELECT store_id, business_date sale_date, net_sales_before_returns n, receipts r FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND store_id<900)
SELECT count(*) rows_compared, sum(CASE WHEN a.n IS NULL OR c.n IS NULL OR abs(a.n-c.n)>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) amt_diff, sum(CASE WHEN a.r IS DISTINCT FROM c.r THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) rec_diff, sum(a.n) mine, sum(c.n) ctrl
FROM a FULL JOIN c USING (store_id, sale_date)

calls.statement: SELECT count(*) receipts_multi FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT store_key)>1 OR count(DISTINCT sale_date)>1 OR count(DISTINCT staff_purchase_flag)>1)

SELECT s.format, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id < 900
  AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
